claim.owner: CyberAlchemy v2 Knowledge Exchange Protocol product owner

canonical_proposition.representation:
((pre.owns grantor = true /\
    pre.owns recipient = false /\
    grantor ≠ recipient /\
    pre.knowledgeConsideration = 0) ->
    let post := successfulGrant pre recipient operation
    post.owns grantor = true /\
    post.owns recipient = true /\
    post.envelopeCommitted recipient = true /\
    post.replayConsumed operation = true /\
    post.revision = pre.revision + 1 /\
    post.knowledgeConsideration = 0) /\
  rejectedGrant pre = pre

assumptions: Identity and OperationId have decidable equality
successfulGrant is the modeled atomic successor and not a Solana runtime implementation
knowledgeConsideration models protocol price and excludes separately observed network fees

claim_ceiling: Candidate proposition over one pure Lean model of the core grant transition. A checked theorem establishes only modeled preservation of A, addition of B, envelope recording, revision increment, replay consumption, zero knowledge consideration, and rejection identity. It does not admit the business ontology or DomainSpec, prove Solana runtime conformance, signer/account correctness, real replay rejection, storage, cryptographic security, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
